**Braid groups and Hodge theory**

*Curtis T. McMullen*

64 pp, 14 sections.

**Abstract.** This paper gives an account of the unitary representations of the braid group that arise via the Hodge theory of cyclic branched cover- ings of P1, highlighting their connections with ergodic theory, complex reﬂection groups, moduli spaces of 1-forms and open problems in sur- face topology.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Topological preliminaries; 3 From Hodge theory to topology; 4 Action of the braid group; 5 Complex reﬂection groups; 6 The period map; 7 Arithmetic groups; 8 Factors of the Jacobian; 9 Deﬁnite integrals; 10 Complex hyperbolic geometry; 11 Lifting homological symmetries; 12 The hyperelliptic case; 13 Polygons and Teichm¨uller curves
